info.name: app
info.description:
Stroyopttorg backend — REST API v1.

## Setup
1. Import `postman-variables.json` and select the `local` environment.
2. Run **auth → register**.
3. Copy the 6-digit code from the runserver console into the `otp_code` variable, then run **auth → verify**.
4. Run **auth → login** — it stores `access_token` and `refresh_token` automatically, and every authenticated request inherits Bearer auth from the collection.

Public requests are marked `noauth` and need no token.

item.name: auth

request.description:
Creates an UNVERIFIED account and emails a 6-digit code.
In development the message is printed to the runserver console — put the code in the `otp_code` variable.

Registering an existing email returns 400 and leaves that account untouched.
Single-use code. Activates the account.
Invalidates the previous code and sends a new one. Subject to a cooldown; always returns 200 so accounts cannot be probed.
Link-based alternative to the 6-digit code.

Returns an access/refresh pair and stores both in the environment.

401 = wrong credentials, 403 = email not verified.

A guest cart from this session is merged into the account.
Blacklists the refresh token. The access token remains valid until it expires — the client must discard it.
Always 200, even for unknown addresses.
Opens a 30-minute window for reset-password.
Consumes the code and revokes every refresh token for the account.

item.description: Registration, verification, login, logout and password reset.

item.name: catalog

request.description: Filterable attributes, ordered as configured per category.
Matches name, article and description.

Every filter composes. price_min/price_max are accepted as aliases of min_price/max_price.

ordering: price, created_at, name, rating, sold_count, review_count — prefix with '-' to reverse.
Repeatable. Repeating one code ORs its values; different codes AND together.
Images, attributes, stock, rating and review count.
Published reviews only.
Server-computed average and per-star distribution.
2-4 products, no duplicates, nothing persisted. Returns an attribute matrix with shared rows first.
Max 4 products, all from the same category.

item.description: Public catalogue: categories, brands, products, comparison.

item.name: cart

request.description: Quantity is added to any existing line. Price always comes from the database — a price in the body is ignored.
quantity 0 removes the line.

item.description: Works for guests (session cookie — keep the Postman cookie jar enabled) and for signed-in users. Logging in merges the guest cart into the account cart.

item.name: user

request.description: is_staff, is_superuser, is_active and email are not writable; sending them has no effect.
Revokes every refresh token — log in again afterwards.
The owner comes from the token; a `user` field is ignored.
Demotes every other address; only one default per user.
Duplicates return 400 (unique per user + product).
Filter with ?status=, ?delivery_type=, ?payment_method=.

Built from the server-side cart inside one transaction: stock is locked and re-checked, prices re-read, snapshots written, stock decremented and the cart emptied.

delivery_type: delivery | pickup
payment_method: card | on_delivery | invoice
Allowed while new / awaiting_payment / processing. Returns the reserved stock.
403 unless you have purchased the product. New reviews start unpublished and await moderation.

item.description: The signed-in user's own resources. Everything is scoped to the token — another account's id returns 404, never data.

request.description: Aggregated landing-page payload: banners, categories, popular, best-selling, new, discounted and featured products, promotions and news. Redis-cached.
Published items only.
Expired promotions are excluded.
Write-only. type: callback | price_request | consultation | one_click. Consent is mandatory; leads are never readable publicly.
